result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one major layout/content overlap issue and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time text '25–35 min' overlaps with the delivery cost text '€0 delivery', causing both strings to render on top of each other and become unreadable (visible as '25-3€0 deliverydel...').
issues.suggestion: Separate the delivery time and delivery cost into distinct UI elements with proper spacing, or place them on separate lines to avoid text collision.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated due to insufficient horizontal space, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the restaurant name to wrap to a second line, reduce font size slightly, or increase the card width to accommodate longer names.
